name: TV2-bisection-backwards
old: for (let i = 0; i < refine; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (under(m)) hi = m; else lo = m; }
new: for (let i = 0; i < refine; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (under(m)) lo = m; else hi = m; }
note: The bracket closes on its far end: a click lands a stride beyond where it was aimed.

name: TV2-stride-steps-over-a-ridge
old: export function groundHit(eye, dir, heightAt, { maxDist = TV_PICK_MAX, stepMin = TV_PICK_STEP_MIN,
new: export function groundHit(eye, dir, heightAt, { maxDist = TV_PICK_MAX, stepMin = 40,
note: A 40 m stride walks through a hedge-row ridge and lands the walk on the far side of it.

name: TV2-unbuilt-not-said
note: A click past the built grid reads as a click on the sky - nothing said.

name: TV2-harbour-town-is-water
old:
if (place) return { kind: 'place', place };
  if (water) return { kind: 'water' };
new:
if (water) return { kind: 'water' };
  if (place) return { kind: 'place', place };
note: A town on a water pixel (every harbour) is refused as the sea.

name: TV2-half-an-edge-is-a-road
note: A road that ends at a pixel's edge, or runs beside another, is walked as if it went through.

name: TV2-route-swims
note: The planner walks the traveller into the bay (and Travel Options stops them at the ocean).

name: TV2-legs-ignore-the-ground
old: const same = next && next.x - pixels[i].x === dx && next.y - pixels[i].y === dy && (kinds[i] ?? 'open') === kind;
new: const same = next && next.x - pixels[i].x === dx && next.y - pixels[i].y === dy;
note: A leg that leaves the road keeps the road's reckless speed across the field.

name: TV2-governor-no-floor
old: export const stepDown = (n) => Math.max(TV_GOV_FLOOR, Math.floor(n / TV_GOV_STEP) * TV_GOV_STEP);
new: export const stepDown = (n) => Math.floor(n / TV_GOV_STEP) * TV_GOV_STEP;
note: The ceiling halves to nothing and the journey stands still under a sky of holes.

name: TV2-governor-no-hold
note: One frame's pop-in halves the clock - and at 60 fps it is at walking pace in a tenth of a second.

name: TV2-governor-past-the-spinner
note: The clock runs at the governor's ceiling, faster than the player asked.

name: TV2-governor-hole-keeps-the-clean-clock
note: A hole in the middle of a clean stretch still counts toward the climb.

name: TV2-quiet-arrival-boxed
old:
if (typeof quiet === 'function' ? quiet() : quiet) say(T.MsgArrived);
    else messageBox(T.MsgArrived);
note: Every click's arrival opens a box, and the box brings the view down.

name: TV2-a-new-autopilot-each-leg
old:
if (st.autopilot == null) st.autopilot = new TravelAutopilot(leg, rect, routeLegSpeed(leg.kind));
    else st.autopilot.initTargetRect(leg, rect, routeLegSpeed(leg.kind));
note: The yaw latch is zeroed at every leg (AUDIT-TO1 K1's bug) - an interrupt mid-route snaps the look north.

name: TV2-resume-from-the-start
note: A resumed route walks back to the first leg it began with.

name: TV2-mod-journey-keeps-the-route
old: st.route = null;   // TV2: a journey of the mod's replaces the view's
note: The map's resume prompt later resumes a route the player already replaced.

name: TV2-plate-while-rising
note: A plate under the finger as the camera rises starts a journey the player never aimed (PERF-TV: the plate's click and the ground's share the one gate).

name: TV2-route-line-through-the-camera
note: The line joins a point in front to one after a point behind the eye - a stroke across the whole screen.

name: TV2-undiscovered-named
old: if (!row || !travelCheckDiscovered(row)) return null;   // DFU's own law: an undiscovered place has no name to go to
note: Every town in the view is named and routed to before the player has heard of it.

name: TV2-ray-from-the-head
note: The ray from the head through a matrix built at the raised eye lands the click hundreds of metres off.

name: TV2-no-cap
old: travelViewGovern(dt);   // TV2: under the travel view the clock runs no faster than the land loads
note: The view shows holes at x100: Mac's "cap it to what loads cleanly" never runs.

name: AUDIT-TV-A1-line-by-pixel
old: tvTrip.natives = routeDrawPoints(state.worldCoords(player.pos), legs, { x: rect.cx, z: rect.cz }, tvLegMid);
new: tvTrip.natives = routeDrawPoints(state.worldCoords(player.pos), plan.pixels.slice(1), { x: rect.cx, z: rect.cz }, tvLegMid);
note: The leg index cuts a per-pixel list: the line doubles back over ground already walked.

name: AUDIT-TV-A2-the-spinner-past-the-cap
note: A ring walk capped at x15 by the mod is run at the spinner's x30 under the view.

name: AUDIT-TV-A3-the-ring-watch-kept
note: A click during a ring walk starts a journey the ring's crossing watch stops at the first pixel middle, silently.

name: AUDIT-TV-A4-a-stopped-spot-lingers
note: A camped spot trip's mark, line and words stay on the view for good with nothing driving.

name: AUDIT-TV-A5-the-margin-next-door
old: const summary = tvPlaceSummary(pix.x + dx, pix.y + dy);
new: const summary = dx || dy ? null : tvPlaceSummary(pix.x, pix.y);
note: A click at a walled city's gate - its margin is in the neighbouring pixel - walks to a spot outside instead.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X7-quiet-fixed-at-begin
note: Come down from the view, the arrival is still a line.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X7-host-always-quiet
note: The host says quiet whether the view is up or not.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-3-always-reckless
note: A view journey never stops at low health.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-1-resume-over-the-sea
old: if (d < bestD && dryLine(mp, r.legs[k])) { bestD = d; best = k; }
new: if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = k; }
note: The resume aims straight across the bay into the mod's ocean stop.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-1-host-no-sea
old: isWater: (x, y) => x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= 1000 || y >= 500 || woods.getHeightMapValue(x, y) <= WATER_BYTE,   // AUDIT DEEP T2-1
note: The host hands Travel Options no sea to ask.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-2-walking-teaches-x1
note: Streaming lag at x1 teaches a ceiling of 1.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-8-climb-by-odd-steps
note: The climb goes 1, 6, 11 - not the spinner's steps.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-2-the-outer-ring-counted
note: A view to the horizon holds every journey to x1 after each crossing.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-8-old-ceiling-kept
old:
partyWalkBegin({ pixel: summary.pixel });   // TV8: the party walks with me, if I lead one gathered
    travelGovernor.reset();
new: partyWalkBegin({ pixel: summary.pixel });   // TV8: the party walks with me, if I lead one gathered
note: A new click's road journey inherits the last one's ceiling.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-5-swim-the-corner
old: if (ax !== bx && ay !== by && isWater(bx, ay) && isWater(ax, by)) return -1;
note: The planner cuts a diagonal between two water pixels.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-4-plates-outlive-the-load
old: tvPlates = { at: null, list: [] };   // AUDIT DEEP T2-4
note: The loaded character sees plates of places they never found.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-6-distance-to-the-bend
note: The panel says arriving at every bend.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-7-the-generated-roads
note: The planner walks the port's generated network with Basic Roads off.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T2-8-coordinates-forbidden
old: if (travelOptions?.settings?.targetCoordsAllowed === false) tvSay(TRAVEL_VIEW_TEXT.placesOnly); else travelViewWalkTo(hit.point, pix);
note: A spot journey where the mod forbids coordinates.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X6-the-reason-unshown
note: The held rate never says why.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B6-first-box-wins
note: A road just past the first search box loses to open ground inside it - 6.6% of real 24-pixel trips cost more than they should.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B6-always-the-widest
note: Every route is searched in every box, the short hop on a road included - three searches where one proves the best.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B2-no-settle
note: One pixel building takes x40 to x1 inside a second - the rate just cut never had time to show.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B2-settle-forever
note: After one cut every later hole waits the long settle - holes stand on the screen for two seconds each.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B2-the-reach-again
note: Only the ring the top edge's middle reaches is counted - the picture's corners show unbuilt ground the cap never saw.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B5-water-by-the-byte
note: A click on the sea in a land pixel walks the traveller into it; one on the sand in a sea pixel is refused.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-B4-out-of-a-duel-by-click
note: A click in the view starts a journey out of a live duel that the map refuses.
